research_purposes.description: Develop a missing foundational interface or behavior from little or no prior capability.
research_purposes.central_question: Did a usable developmental milestone appear?

research_purposes.description: Extend a capability already established on one lineage with additional curriculum or practice.
research_purposes.central_question: Did the capability advance without unacceptable loss of retained behavior?

research_purposes.description: Test a preregistered causal or mechanistic claim about Ninereeds or its training.
research_purposes.central_question: Which preregistered observations support or contradict the hypothesis?

research_purposes.description: Repeat an earlier result under the same or deliberately varied conditions.
research_purposes.central_question: Does the finding recur, and within which boundary?

research_purposes.description: Separate competing explanations for an observed behavior or activation change.
research_purposes.central_question: Which intervention distinguishes the competing mechanisms?

research_purposes.description: Map where a learned behavior transfers, persists, or breaks under controlled changes.
research_purposes.central_question: What is the controlled generalization boundary?

research_purposes.description: Study interference, damage, healing, or restoration after another intervention.
research_purposes.central_question: What was lost, what returned, and what changed during recovery?

research_purposes.description: Stabilize established behavior or combine compatible evidence-backed gains.
research_purposes.central_question: Did stability improve without hiding unresolved weaknesses?

research_purposes.description: A purpose not represented above; requires an explicit definition.
research_purposes.central_question: What makes this purpose distinct from the registered choices?

execution_designs.description: Continue one checkpoint lineage with a bounded intervention.
Hold the design fixed while removing or changing one declared factor.
Produce comparable branches with declared script or curriculum variation; preserve all branches and delay ranking until evidence is complete.
Compare otherwise matched branches with different ordering or interleaving.
Compare matched text, image, or combined experiences.
Combine declared specialist lineages using an architecture-specific procedure and test retention and interference.
Apply bounded joint or corrective experience after regression or merge interference.
Vary a declared quantity such as examples, duration, or model scale while holding other factors fixed.
Vary declared diversity in scripts, examples, surfaces, or ordering and compare complete branches.
A design not represented above; requires an explicit procedure and comparison logic.

rule: Research purpose and execution design are independent selections; neither implies the other.
